Done — [architecture/RESUME_2026-07-18_EOD.md](architecture/RESUME_2026-07-18_EOD.md) is committed (`14ac344`). It captures the one fragile thing (M10's uncommitted reindex work in the working tree and the unknown outcome of the instrumented dogfood run, with exactly where to look), the next steps in order, and the reminder that commits after `359b8b9` haven't been pushed to origin yet.

It was a genuinely big day: the identity pipeline went live on real commits, the agent write path (`annotate`) and repair tooling (`relink`/`reconcile`) landed, the R4 bug got found-by-dogfooding and fixed, M9's embedding layer shipped, server-free sync was proven against real GitHub, and — the part you can actually look at tonight — **`.git-for-ai\report.html`** is sitting there ready to open in your browser.

When usage resets, just say "continue" — the resume note plus `git for-ai log --intent` will bring the next session up to speed in a minute. Enjoy the report.
Picking up from the resume note. First: what happened to the instrumented dogfood run overnight?

body.text: All 101 CLI tests pass (17 new from reindex). Reviewing the reindex header and its bin.ts wiring:

attributes.command: cd C:/src/git-for-ai && grep -n "export interface ReportOptions" -A 12 packages/cli/src/commands/report.ts
cd C:/src/git-for-ai/packages/cli && pnpm build 2>&1 | tail -2 && cd ../.. && git for-ai reindex 2>/dev/null && git for-ai report

cd C:/src/git-for-ai && git add packages/cli/src/commands/reindex.ts packages/cli/src/commands/reindex.test.ts packages/cli/src/bin.ts && git commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
M10: reindex over the M9 pipeline; wire reindex + report into the CLI

git for-ai reindex indexes all three content kinds into one embedding
space per ARCHITECTURE §11.1: tree-sitter code chunks (diff-driven
incremental from state.json's last_indexed_commit), effective ledger
entries (one per change; superseded/folded skipped), and session
summaries (never raw spans). --full drops index.db but keeps embcache;
--verify audits without rebuilding. Model weights cache per-user under
LOCALAPPDATA/git-for-ai/models (survives node_modules wipes),
override via GIT_FOR_AI_MODEL_CACHE. Embedding is batched with durable
checkpoints after every batch — the fix for the first dogfood run,
which stalled invisibly for an hour inside one all-chunks embed call.

Dogfooded on this repo with the real model: first full index 716 code
chunks + 13 ledger + 12 sessions (DONE_OK); second incremental pass
embedded only the 2 chunks the intervening commit touched. 17 new
tests (injectable fake embedder, real git fixtures); CLI suite 101
passing, independently re-run before commit.

Also wires the already-committed report command into bin.ts:
`git for-ai report` writes .git-for-ai/report.html by default
(--md for Markdown to stdout), verified end-to-end.

Implemented by a background Fable 5 agent; reviewed, re-verified, and
wired by the orchestrating session.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push origin main "+refs/notes/git-for-ai/*:refs/notes/git-for-ai/*" "+refs/git-for-ai/*:refs/git-for-ai/*" 2>&1 | tail -4
